question: Part Lifecycle, status confirmations: the design draws a close X at the top right of every status confirmation (Deactivate part?, Activate part?, Deactivate parts?, Activate parts?). The PRD lists only a title, a message, an optional note, Cancel and a confirm button. (a) Should the X be there? (b) If yes, does clicking it do the same as Cancel (nothing changes, and from the part window the picked status is kept)?

Part Lifecycle, Part Library entry page: the note on design board 7.2 still says an entry "can be edited and deleted" on its page, while the PRD (S11-R3) says the page itself has no Delete button and Delete sits in the Edit Library Part window. The board's picture shows no Delete. Can you confirm the PRD is right and the note is out of date? Our cases follow the PRD.

Part Lifecycle, Part History: when an entry is long (for example a part number change with "| Changed at: <location>"), the design (board 2.6) wraps it onto a second line inside the Event column. The engineering plan says the Event text is cut off with "..." instead. Which one is right: (a) wrap onto more lines, or (b) cut off with "..."? If (b), how does a user read the full entry?
